verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export or account-exit feature. The API endpoint that returns a collection of candidates is a developer building block for building an export, not the capability itself. The XML feed covers only published jobs for job-board syndication, so it is an adjacent feature rather than a full export in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
